note: Small park on the east side of Wamego (400 E Military Trail Rd): concrete pull-throughs beside an industrial park, with a railroad just south across the road. Showers are seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm $35 FHU pull-through ($18 no-utility tent/RV site; fees 35 -> 18-35), 30/50 A full hookups, 12 sites (8 pull-through + 4), laundry/seasonal shower/WiFi, open year round, RoverPass booking, 90-day max stay. Pin on the pull-throughs.
flags: FEES BASE: the $18 sites are listed as '4 Campsites (Tent/RV)' with no utilities; no pad size is given for them, so whether a 23-ft motorhome fits is not stated (the $35 pull-throughs are 12 x 70 ft). If AWH reads the $18 sites as tent-first, nightly_low should be 35. Either way the gate passes.

PRIVATE GATE: passes - $35 (or $18) under US$50; presence: website + phone (785) 456-2267 confirmed + RoverPass booking; Google 4.5/59 (stored 4.5/60); RV Life 4*/$$ (18 reviews).
